project_type: Lua scripting for SA-MP Android using MonetLoader engine
build_system: No build system - Lua scripts are loaded directly by MonetLoader on Android device. Validation is syntax-only via luac or lua parser.
test_framework: No automated tests - testing is done on device. Validation can be done via Lua syntax check (luac -p).
test_command: luac -p ChatEngine.lua && luac -p chatengine_lib.lua && echo 'Syntax OK'
verification_instructions: 1. Run luac -p on both files to verify no syntax errors. 2. Review code structure matches MonetLoader patterns from reference scripts.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - files are standalone Lua scripts placed in the repo root.
environment_constraints: Cannot run the scripts (MonetLoader Android runtime only). Can only validate Lua syntax. No luac available in sandbox - use lua 5.1 or basic syntax validation.
contribution_requirements: Follow camelCase naming, safe pcall loading for optional libs, clear comments, error handling with nil checks, performance-conscious for mobile.
key_patterns: 1. require 'mimgui' (NOT 'imgui'). 2. imgui.OnFrame(condition_fn, render_fn) with self.HideCursor. 3. PushStyleVarFloat for float vars, PushStyleVarVec2 for vec2 vars, PushStyleColor for colors. 4. MONET_DPI_SCALE global for DPI. 5. Safe pcall loading for optional libs. 6. samp.events loaded as local and functions assigned as sampev.onServerMessage. 7. inicfg.load/save for config. 8. sampRegisterChatCommand for commands. 9. script_name/script_author at top. 10. TextColored(imgui.ImVec4(r,g,b,a), text) for colored text.
relevant_files: ChatEngineTest.lua (reference for samp.events hook pattern, return false blocking)
RadialMenu.lua (reference for inicfg config, PushStyleVarFloat/Vec2, dark theme styling)
CompassNav.lua (reference for OnFrame overlay, PushStyleVarFloat/Vec2, DPI scaling)
PlayerStatsWidget.lua (reference for PushStyleColor, config window, imgui.new.bool/float)
MonetLoader-lib-full/notifications.lua (reference for MONET_DPI_SCALE usage, fade animations)
directory_structure: Root contains .lua script files. MonetLoader-lib-full/ contains all libraries (mimgui/, samp/, inicfg.lua, fAwesome6.lua, notifications.lua). Scripts use require to load from lib folder.
